title: Vishal:
headline: Why Kiva is different, from the CEO: $25 gives you agency over problems that feel too big, and everyday people fund it and see exactly where the money goes.
story: Big problems like climate change or poverty feel too big to solve.
With Kiva it can be $25 or $50. That agency makes people feel part of the solution, not burdened.
Everyday people fund it, and they see transparently what happens to their money.
do: Cold open on “Often we see large problems…”, him mid-walk.
Keep both arguments, in order: agency, then everyday people + transparency.
Name super after the hook: “Vishal Ghotge” / “CEO of Kiva”, small, lower corner.
Cover every trim with Block 3 BROLL.
End card: “Give a little. Change a lot.” + kiva.org.
dont: Do not open with who he is.
Not a soft personal reflection or Kiva boilerplate.
Don't let the optional graft push the cut past 1:30.
No name plate, logo or fade at 0:00.
Never the transcript's spelling of his name.
No big lime captions. Brit's caption spec only.
